semantics: Interorbital distance as a fraction of L (cat +50 widest, red fox -25 narrowest). Moves the seats, not the eyeballs' size; a continuous brow bar spans this width without moving the eyes (brow-study section 5.8). A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
